outcome: The Financial MIS statement is now served. POST api/mis/statement returns Srihari's statement as a tree: the workbook outline at its natural depth, every parent a subtotal derived from its own leaves, the grand total footing, rows in outline order, each carrying its S.No, Budget Component and leaf GL. Budget, Roll-over, Actual and % come back for the selected month and FY 26-27 YTD - a single block when the selected period is itself the YTD - with money as a fixed-scale decimal string so paise survive the wire, and the unmapped-GL line visible with its own Actual counted in the total. Making it work required the governed path to exist at all: a registered statement domain with its own grant, and the bounded LIMIT the validator demands.
